value.rationale: The first centered polynomial moment is a natural Brownian path-information channel (Foster et al. 2019). Its full two-stratum marginal-preserving dependence design is solved exactly, including a strict and uniquely optimal antithetic pairing despite a non-Monge interior cost and an explicit global sum-of-nonnegative-factors certificate. The relative improvement 2/125 over independent/common shifts is small but a physically interpretable exact resource-free improvement and an optimality boundary; no general-sensor claim is made.
